STEP 2 - Vessel: A white square-ish dinner plate, about 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: scrambled eggs, pineapple chunks, watermelon cubes, honeydew melon cubes, spinach leaves, carrot shreds, and a cucumber or zucchini round.

Total ≈ 143 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 230 g of mostly fruit and a modest egg portion, covering roughly half a dinner plate, gives a plausible total of around 140 kcal. Fruit dominates the weight, and the eggs contribute most of the energy.
